newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair sets fares to mark collaboration.
newsitem.headline: Swissair sets fares to mark collaboration.

text.p: Swissair AG said it and its three partners -- Delta Air Lines, Sabena and Austrian Airlines -- were setting special fares on the North Atlantic routes to introduce increased collaboration.

Swissair said in a statement that around 200 U.S. destinations would be available from Switzerland at the new prices, which will be valid for return flights from Switzerland between January 9 and March 20.
Reservations must be made between January 9-28.
Examples of the fares are 590 Swiss francs between Switzerland to Boston or Pittsburg and 1,290 francs to Honolulu and Maui in Hawaii.
Swissair announced the new collaboration on December 19, which expands the partnership among the airlines to the most extensive inter-airline collaboration on the North Atlantic.

The new "joint operation" includes additional codeshare flights, extension of non-smoking arrangements to all partners' flights, all flights will be bookable via any of the four carriers, while revenue will be divided up under a jointly-agreed formula.
On Tuesday Delta announced it would overhaul its trans-Atlantic and intra-European flights and also introduce a second daily flight to Zurich from Atlanta.
